newsitem.title: USA: Novavax gets FDA OK to proceed with study.
newsitem.headline: Novavax gets FDA OK to proceed with study.

text.p: Novavax Inc said Monday it received permissiion from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to proceed with pharmacokinetic-dose response studies of Androsorb in testosterone-deficient males.

It said Androsorb, its proprietary topical micellar nanoparticle cream containing testosterone, is one in a series of encapsulated topical drug product candidates using Novavax's proprietary delivery technology to enter the response studies.
In the study to be conducted, an initial group of 10 men will receive 30 mg. of testosterone twice each day for 30 days, it said.
As part of the study, Novavax said it also received approval to dose additional groups of men at higher or lower doses.
Novavax said Androsorb is being developed as a simple replacement treatment for testosterone-deficient men.

It said testosterone replacement therapy in men helps maintain muscle mass, increases energy and libido, and helps prevent osteoporosis. Current forms of testosterone replacement therapy include intramuscular injections and patch transdermal delivery systems.
Androsorb is Novavax's second product candidate using the micellar nanoparticle drug delivery cream in human clinical trials.
It said it is currently conducting pharmacokinetic-dose response studies of its Estrasorb topical encapsulated estradiol cream in menopausal women.
